clauses.scope_note: Applies to Client’s access to or use of the Cohere Products under the Client License Agreement. Client must comply with applicable export-control, sanctions, and trade laws; must not make the Products available to specified restricted destinations, persons, or end uses; and must not use them in a way that causes unauthorized export or disclosure of controlled technical information. Cohere may suspend or terminate access if it reasonably determines the access or use may violate applicable export-control or sanctions laws.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to making Products available to a restricted location, a sanctioned or restricted party, or a prohibited end use, and to access or use resulting in unauthorized export or disclosure of controlled technical information. Applicable-law compliance is an obligation; the listed prohibited circumstances are not permissions.

clauses.scope_note: If Client submits ideas, suggestions, documents, or proposals regarding the Cohere Products, Cohere may use, commercialize, or disclose that Feedback worldwide for any purpose and in any manner, or choose not to do so, without compensating or reimbursing Client. Client acknowledges Feedback is not confidential or proprietary and Cohere has no confidentiality obligation for it. This is a right concerning submitted Feedback, not a grant to Client to use Cohere Products.
clauses.condition_explanation: The clause applies when Client submits Feedback. The stated restriction is that the Feedback does not contain confidential or proprietary information; no confidentiality obligation or compensation is imposed on Cohere.

clauses.clause_label: North Product Terms §2(a)–(b) License Grant and Delivery
clauses.scope_note: For North entitlements stated in the applicable Order Form, Client may permit limited access to and use of a copy of North hosted in the Client Environment, only to the extent required for Clients to use North functionality. The entitlement also includes access to one instance of necessary Cohere Models (Embed, Rerank, Command) and Compass, as specified by Cohere, only as necessary to support North. Standalone Cohere Models use is excluded unless expressly included in the applicable Order Form. These are North-schedule entitlements, not general permission for other Cohere Products or standalone model use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The North entitlement must be included in the applicable Order Form. Hosted-copy access is limited to what is required for Clients’ use of North functionality and remains subject to the CLA, including Client responsibilities. Included model and Compass use is limited to what is necessary to support North; standalone model use requires express Order Form inclusion.

clauses.clause_label: North Product Terms §3(a)(i) Additional North Restrictions
clauses.scope_note: Applies to installation or hosting of North in a Client Environment. The Client must use an environment meeting Cohere’s minimum requirements provided to Client and implement Cohere’s provided technical prerequisites before installation.
clauses.condition_explanation: Before installation, Client must satisfy both the minimum-environment requirement and the technical-prerequisite implementation requirement.

clauses.scope_note: North offers an option for Client to enable North Tools so North Users can access and query organizational data in external sources from within North, limited to data the Users otherwise have access to. Third-party portions outside Cohere’s control are Third-Party Products under the Agreement. Client is responsible for choosing which tools to enable and for managing and configuring access controls in those Third-Party Products.
clauses.condition_explanation: The access-and-query functionality is available when Client enables a North Tool, and the described data access is limited to organizational data the relevant Users otherwise have access to. Client must manage the external-product access controls.

clauses.clause_label: North Product Terms §5(a)–(b) License Metric Based Restrictions
clauses.scope_note: For North licensed by a defined North User count, included fees cover use up to the Order Form limit; excess users incur the stated per-user North Incremental User Fee. Removed users count toward the limit until 90 days after their associated accounts are fully decommissioned, as demonstrated by Client’s written records. For TPM-based licensing, exceeding the Order Form TPM entitlement at any time during its term makes a fee immediately due to Partner for the remainder of that term, based on Order Form pricing; incremental purchases must cover the maximum TPM reached at any time.
clauses.condition_explanation: The applicable metric and limits come from the Order Form. Use above the user or TPM entitlement requires the applicable incremental fees. For user-count reduction, both 90 days after full decommissioning and Client’s written-record demonstration apply.

clauses.clause_label: Commercial SaaS Agreement introductory access restrictions
clauses.scope_note: Applies to access to the Cohere API SaaS Services, including the website, under the Commercial SaaS Agreement. Access for availability, performance, or functionality monitoring, other benchmarking, or competitive purposes is prohibited. Cohere’s direct competitors may not access the services unless Cohere gives prior written consent.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when access is for monitoring or benchmarking, or when the accessing party is a direct Cohere competitor. Prior written Cohere consent is an express exception only to the competitor-access prohibition; the text does not state it as an exception to the benchmarking restriction.
